text:
Chris: Hey, so I finally bought a hardware wallet. I want to move my ETH off MetaMask.
Dana: Good call. Did you set it up already?
Chris: Yeah, I set a PIN, wrote down the twenty-four words on the card. Um, I put it in a drawer. Is that okay?
Dana: Better in a fireproof place. Maybe make a second copy and keep it somewhere else, like at your parents' house. Just not a photo.
Chris: Right, right. So how do I send it? I'm scared I'll mess up the address.
Dana: Connect the device, open the app, generate a receiving address, and verify it on the device screen. Then in MetaMask, click send, paste the address and send a small test first, like zero point zero one ETH.
Chris: What about gas? I saw the fee is like fifteen dollars right now.
Dana: Network is busy. You could wait for the weekend, gas is usually lower. Or just pay it, it's a one-time thing.
Chris: And tokens, do they need separate transfers?
Dana: Yes, each token is its own transaction, and each one costs gas. So if you've got tiny dust balances, maybe leave them.
Chris: Okay. And then I can remove the old MetaMask wallet?
Dana: Don't delete it until you've confirmed everything arrived. And remember that old seed phrase is still valid, so don't reuse it.
Chris: Got it. Thanks, Dana.
